title: Uganda’s Arts Teachers Strike Disrupts Schools Amid Pay Dispute
description: Arts teachers in Uganda are on strike, demanding fairer salaries. The nationwide disruption threatens students’ exam preparations as negotiations with the government continue.
author: Kyoga TV News Desk

title: Local Artist Releases New Hit
description: Kyoga TV reports on the latest single from our favorite local artist that's topping the charts.
author: Kyoga TV Music Desk

title: Breaking News: Kyoga TV Experiences Theft of Critical Equipment
description: On July 29, 2025, Kyoga TV suffered a significant setback when their computer, serving as both a playout system and video switcher, was stolen from Omoro Town Council. The suspect was apprehended on August 28. CEO Felix Olica confirmed the development and assured resumption of normal operations. Kyoga TV content remains accessible online through their website and social media platforms.
author: Kyoga TV News Desk

title: Museveni Urges Lango to Form Committee to Resolve Stalled Cattle Compensation
description: President Museveni has called on the people of Lango sub-region to select a trusted committee to engage the government on the long-stalled cattle compensation program. Residents demand transparency, prioritization of verified claims, and elimination of middlemen. The committee’s formation is seen as a potential solution to restore trust and expedite payments.
author: Olica Felix

title: Seven Dead After Boat Capsizes on Lake Kyoga in Northern Uganda
description: A tragic accident occurred on Lake Kyoga in Amolatar District on September 19, 2025, when a boat carrying 36 passengers capsized, resulting in seven fatalities and 29 survivors. The victims have been identified as Steven Odeke (65) from Muchora Abino A village, Catherine Aguti (55) from Okwalongen Sub-county, Dokolo District, Sylvia Abonyo (35) from Amuda village, Soroti District, Jaspher Ogwal (38) from Corner Bileo Trading Centre, Arwotcek Sub-county, Robina Ejang (30) from Alemere Bung Cell, Epel Ward, Semmy Agwech (20) from Etam Sub-county, and Aboyi Nama (male adult, area not specified). The boat struck a tree stump near Kiryanga Village, and authorities are investigating the incident while urging residents to adhere to safety regulations on the lake.
